requirements.definition: I shall be an integer value in the range of the collating sequence for the specified kind, and KIND, if present, shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

requirements.title: CHAR returns one character of the selected or default kind
requirements.definition: The result is character of length one; present KIND selects the character kind, and absent KIND selects default character kind.

pending.present-KIND-selects-character-kind: Guarded plan: integer, parameter :: ascii = selected_char_kind('ASCII'). If ascii >= 0, exercise CHAR(ICHAR('A'),KIND=ascii), check LEN(result) == 1 and KIND(result) == ascii, and mutate the requested or expected kind so the KIND check is load-bearing. If ascii < 0, the processor provides no ASCII character kind, so this nondefault character-kind facet is not exercised on that processor; default-kind CHAR facets still apply.
pending.absent-KIND-default-character-kind: Left pending by intrinsics_16_9_e: no load-bearing portable fixture is shipped for this facet on both validation toolchains.
